breakdown.description: The aluminium and steel subdomains are swapped between the top and bottom halves
breakdown.reason: The agent did not fix the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that the top half was steel and the bottom half was aluminium. The agent repeated this error, specifying 'Define the top subdomain... as material 'Steel'' and 'Define the bottom subdomain... as material 'Aluminium''. The ground truth correctly identifies the top half as aluminium and the bottom half as steel.
